html:
Experience the Ambassador Day Cruise, one of the most luxurious day cruises in Halong Bay. The vessel offers spacious twin sundecks with 360 degree views over the bay, elegant lounges, two fine dining restaurants, two bars, and an open air Jacuzzi. Sightseeing, premium cuisine, and entertainment come together for a memorable journey through this UNESCO World Heritage Site.

ITINERARY

08:00 – Check-in and Transfer to Ambassador Day Cruise

Guests check in at the Ambassador’s Lounge located on the first floor of Halong International Cruise Port. After check-in, guests are transferred to the Ambassador Day Cruise vessel.

09:00 – Light Breakfast Onboard

Enjoy a light breakfast while the cruise departs the port and sails into the majestic landscape of Halong Bay and Bai Tu Long Bay.

10:30 – Visit Sung Sot Cave

Explore Sung Sot Cave, the largest and most remarkable cave in Halong Bay, with its dramatic stalactites and rock formations.

11:30 – Visit Titov Island

Arrive at Titov Island. Guests may swim in the clear turquoise water or climb to the top of the island for panoramic views of the bay.

12:00 – Premium Lunch at the Restaurant

Savor a premium lunch at the cruise restaurant while the vessel continues cruising through scenic parts of Halong Bay.

13:30 – Visit Luon Cave

Enjoy optional kayaking or a bamboo boat ride around Luon Cave to admire the cave’s interior and surrounding emerald waters. (*Kayaking and rowing boat services have additional charges.)

14:20 – Afternoon Tea

Relax with afternoon tea in the restaurant areas on the third and fourth floors while soaking in the views.

15:00 – Live Music Entertainment

Enjoy live music on the sundeck as part of afternoon entertainment (weather permitting).

16:00 – Disembarkation

Return to Halong International Cruise Port and disembark. The day cruise concludes.

WHAT IS INCLUDED

  • Full day cruise itinerary and program as described above.

  • One light breakfast onboard.

  • One premium lunch at the cruise restaurant.

  • Afternoon tea.

  • Onboard insurance, tax, and service charges.

  • Entrance and sightseeing fees for all scheduled visits.

WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED

  • Airfare and airport transfers.

  • Visa arrangements and onboard cabins.

  • Transportation to and from Halong Bay.

  • Beverages (except those included in the meal set, if stated by operator).

  • Kayaking and bamboo boat rowing at Luon Cave (*charges apply separately).

  • Massage, spa treatments, and personal expenses.

  • Tips and gratuities.

IMPORTANT NOTES

  • The itinerary may be subject to change depending on weather and cruising conditions.

  • Internet access onboard may be limited due to geographical conditions of the bay.

HIGHLIGHTS OF AMBASSADOR DAY CRUISE

  • Stunning views of limestone karsts and emerald waters.

  • Elegant dining with premium cuisine.

  • Spacious sundecks and panoramic vistas.

  • Multiple entertainment options including live music.

  • Outdoor Jacuzzi pool and luxury facilities onboard
